LAW-10.name: cofinish_qstar_split
LAW-10.source: percolator-novel ox:t0496 canonical b25a36a9c32abd7c + ox:t0499 a523246345bee3e2 + ox:t0491 da948f6fcb7460dd (Simultaneous-Finish Split q* LAW Record; coordinate-layer meta-token grounding) + ox:t0494 57f8679483675fe1 (Exact Design for a Stateless, Respawning Seat; design/derivation half)
LAW-10.semantics: A job occupies contiguous span [o, o+m) of m meta-tokens on the memlang coordinate axis. Two lanes P and Q bound to it with measured sustained rates b_P, b_Q (meta-tokens retired/tick, EWMA alpha=1/8 over trailing 64 ticks). Horizon-aggregate bandwidth B_H = b_P + b_Q. Split q* = m*b_P/(b_P+b_Q) gives lane P prefix [o, o+q*) and lane Q suffix [o+q*, o+m); both finish same tick: T_P = q*/b_P = m/B_H = (m-q*)/b_Q = T_Q = T*. Makespan exactly m/B_H.
LAW-10.grounding: path (P or H) = registered resource line in the Ledger of Empty Chairs; chair = atomic unit of capacity; empty chair = capacity posted but unfilled; pump = shared per-tick flow of effort-units from common pool. B_P, B_H = empty chairs remaining on path P/H at reconcile time (int>=0); e_P, e_H = fill efficiency (chairs filled per effort-unit, trailing K=16 ticks, integer mill).
LAW-10.coordinate_layer: Meta-token (mt) = the unit of work on the memlang coordinate axis. 1 mt = a fixed canonical chunk (e.g. 512 payload tokens through the path kernel), defined per schema_version. If the workload is content-heterogeneous, mt must be normalized (raw tokens x cost-class weight, weights carried in the job descriptor), else 'bandwidth in mt/s' is not comparable across paths. Per-mt variance on each path must be <5% or split per cost class.
